waypoints.note: Parking lot for the Snow Lakes Trail, about 1,300 ft. Pay the $5 day-use fee or display a Northwest Forest Pass or interagency pass.
waypoints.directions: Take Icicle Road (FR 7600) out of Leavenworth; the lot sits on the left side about 4.3 mi along.

wa_snow_creek_wall_satellite.notes: Not on Mountain Project, Wenatchee Outdoors or theCrag; The Mountaineers indexes the name only under its Snow Creek Wall page (no facts). Only source: a 2004 CascadeClimbers thread quoting the guidebook (5 pitches, 5.7; starts at a right-facing corner or a 5.2 chimney at the far left of the wall). SummitPost has a Satellite page (summitpost.org/satellite/162086) but is 403 - a second source there would lift both locks to agree-2. Climbers in the thread describe moss and brush on the route. Trailhead pin = centre of the OSM parking lot (way 154033355), 45.6 m from the USFS trailhead point; elevation is the USFS published 1,300 ft (USGS DEM reads 1,374 ft at the lot centre). Straight line lot to the wall centre is 1.75 km, so any one-way dist_km below 1.75 is wrong. dist_km left null (no stored value; The Mountaineers gives 5.0 mi round trip and 2,800 ft gain for the wall outing, Wenatchee Outdoors about 2.5 mi up to the base) - not proposed because the column has two conventions. USFS (updated 2026-08-04): $5/day or $30/yr, NW Forest Pass and Interagency passes accepted; free self-issued day-use wilderness permit at the trailhead; no dogs on the Snow Lakes Trail (Enchantment Permit Area). Whether a Snow Creek Wall day climb needs the day-use wilderness permit was not confirmed - permit not written.
